description: This file defines a report parser class for follow-up print reports in an Odoo module, including methods for retrieving partner addresses, move lines, and follow-up texts.

classes.name: report_rappel
classes.description: A report parser class for follow-up printing, extending report_sxw.rml_parse, with methods to gather partner info, addresses, move lines, and follow-up texts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and updates local context with helper functions.

methods.name: _ids_to_objects
methods.description: Converts partner IDs to partner names using account_followup.stat records.

methods.name: _adr_get
methods.description: Retrieves partner address details based on partner ID and address type.

methods.name: _lines_get
methods.description: Fetches move lines for a partner with receivable account type that are unreconciled and not in draft.

methods.name: _get_text
methods.description: Generates follow-up text for a partner based on follow-up lines and delays, including dynamic string formatting.
